mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 2.0%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is active during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 3.7% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 3.7.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic uncertainty increases.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise) fails to predict negative 20d returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market slowdown (HOUST < 1300 thousand units) and weak consumer spending (RSAFS < 500,000 million dollars), the S&P 500 tends to decline over the next 60 trading days due to reduced economic activity and corporate revenue concerns.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST < 1300 and RSAFS < 500000, the S&P 500 produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When annualized CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals a need for aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as bond yields rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL 12m inflation > 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0) indicates robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profits improve.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 105.0 fails to predict positive 60d returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1300 thousand units signals a slowdown in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and economic growth expectations weaken.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1300 fails to predict negative 20d returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of slowing GDP growth (GDPC1 4q growth rate < 1.0% annualized), the S&P 500 tends to decline over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings outlook and increased recession risk.
failure_condition: In periods of GDPC1 4q growth < 1.0%, SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of cases.
